WHAT IS "THE RUN'S FILES" HERE. The working tree holds the uncommitted work of the whole milestone M0 since the audit AUD-001 release: besides run ISS-0093 (code in tools/src/team and tools/src/pixel-office, tests, decisions 0102, 0105, 0106, the check.yml limit, REQ-102 and its design, the defect files ISS-0093 and ISS-0097..0099, the handoffs of this run) there are the records of earlier closed runs that were never released (M0REQ061-20261028-01, M0EXC-20261028-01, ISS-0094-20261028-01, M0BACKLOG-20261028-01 steps 01-03, AUD-001-20261027-01 steps 06 and 07a, decisions 0101, 0103, 0104, the defect files, docs/owner-requests, docs/program/public-v1) and the shared files docs/requirements.yaml, STATE.md, docs/anti-patterns.md, decisions/README.md, docs/audits/AUD-001/*, which carry the bookkeeping of several runs together and cannot be split by run. The whole tree was tested as one: the full check on GitHub (two runs on temporary snapshot commits, 2135 of 2135 tests green; the files of the last snapshot equal the current ones except documents and bookkeeping that ORCH and DOC-UPDATER wrote after it, and for these the format check, lint and the tests that read documents were run locally and are green). So the first commit holds every changed and new file of the working tree (list them with `git status --short -uall` and name each one in `git add -- <path>`; no `git add -A`, no `git add .`), except: your own handoff (AP-091), the release report if you write it after the commit, and, for the second commit as PLAN 4.4 says, docs/program/public-v1/** (ORCH's files) together with your handoff. Check first that the first commit alone keeps the check green: nothing in tools/ or the tests may depend on a file that you put only in the second commit (look at what the tests read: decisions/, docs/, handoffs/); if in doubt put the file into the first commit. Follow the form of the earlier releases (`git log` of this repository: a commit of the run's files, then «Handoff of the finalizer step of <RUN-ID>»). Name in result.issues, in plain words, that the first commit carries the records of earlier M0 runs as well and why (shared files cannot be split), and list the groups by run so the owner can read it.
ORDER. (1) `git fetch origin`; if `origin/main` is not the local HEAD 6f5a38a (behind or diverged) STOP and report. (2) Check there is no unclosed handoff among the files to commit: every `"status"` of the changed handoffs is COMPLETED or FAILED (list the command and its output), no file with a secret-shaped literal, no scratch or temporary file, nothing from node_modules; `cd tools && npm run handoffs-check` and `npm run traces` clean; do NOT run the full `npm run check` on this 16 GB computer (it runs on GitHub; if the update of `main` brought code changes you would need it, it does not). (3) The commit message of the first commit names the requirement and the defect, e.g. «Result files stored byte-exact: REQ-102, defect ISS-0093 (run ISS-0093-20261028-01); decisions 0102, 0105, 0106; check.yml limit 30 minutes; bookkeeping of the M0 runs after AUD-001», and ends with the line `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. The author is the configured git user; do not change git config. (4) Write the release report docs/releases/ISS-0093-20261028-01.md in the form of the earlier ones: what was done, the checks with links to the handoffs (the check on GitHub run 40968115867 and run 40996714076, 2135 of 2135; the gate passes including the owner's extra passes DG-1..DG-5; the interruptions and re-runs of step 08n and 11), the commits, what was NOT done and why (the full check did not run on this computer; the open Low findings and the defects ISS-0097, ISS-0098, ISS-0099; residual risks (1)-(7); the stale texts), what waits for the owner (nothing new from this run; the M0 owner actions stay in PROGRESS). Do not promise what did not happen. (5) `git push origin main` (ordinary push, no force, no tags, no other branch, no --no-verify), then wait for `check.yml` on the pushed sha (`gh run list --workflow check.yml --branch main --limit 3 --json conclusion,headSha,status,createdAt,databaseId`; the run takes 13-15 minutes of a limit of 30; check at intervals of a few minutes, never a blocking loop longer than ten minutes). A red `check.yml` is NOT fixed and NOT re-run: STOP and report with the real log lines to ORCH (`status` and `result.status` stay IN_PROGRESS, `completed_at` null, the first issue of kind BLOCKED, as the role file says). If a sibling workflow runs (path filter), report it. (6) After the green run: close your handoff and deliver it with the report and docs/program/public-v1/** as the second commit and push it; wait for `check.yml` of the second sha as well and report its result (a handoff and documents commit is expected to be green; if it is red, report and stop). Nothing is deployed (no app/ change). (7) At the end: `git status` shows no uncommitted file of the run (the report and the list), `git log -3`, the remote has only `main` at the new sha. No machine paths and no names of other projects in the report or the handoff; no secret-shaped literal. result.summary: two or three plain Russian sentences for the owner with the numbers of both commits and the results of both check runs.
